show.description: A humble orphan who believes he’s ordinary discovers he’s a once-in-a-generation genius after creating a life-saving formula—only to become the target of a ruthless scientist who tried to have him killed as a child, and will stop at nothing to protect his legacy when the truth threatens to expose everything.
